THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

This appeal is preferred against the Judgment and award dated 01.04.2021 passed in MVC No.406/2019 by the Additional MACT and Additional Senior Civil Judge, Bidar (for short 'the tribunal'), seeking enhancement of the compensation.
2. The claimant suffered injuries in the accident on 14.03.2019.
He took treatment in the Hospital.
He filed claim petition claiming compensation of Rs.20,00,000/- along with interest.
The tribunal considering the entire evidence on record, has awarded a sum of Rs.3,40,166/- along with interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.

Aggrieved by the said Judgment and award, the claimant has preferred the present appeal and contended that, the claimant suffered fracture of NC: 2025:KHC-K:6512 HC-KAR shaft tibia upper 1/3rd right leg which is grievous injury and he has been operated with implants.
Learned counsel for the claimant submits that, meager amounts were granted for pain and sufferings.
Though the Doctor assessed the disability at 32%, the tribunal has erred in taking the disability at 8%.
The claimant was working as Labourer and earning a sum of Rs.15,000/- per month.

But the tribunal has considered Rs.9,000/-
as his monthly income.
Further he submitted that, no amounts were granted for removal of implants, though the Doctor has opined that, a sum of Rs.30,000/- needs for removal of implants.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides.
4.
It is stated that, the claimant was aged 44 years and doing labour work and earning a sum of Rs.15,000/-.
The claimant has not produced any income proof to prove his income.
The claimant met with accident in the year 2019.
Hence, as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, his income is to be taken at Rs.13,250/- per month.
Since the Doctor has assessed the disability at NC: 2025:KHC-K:6512 HC-KAR 32%, 1/3rd of the same comes to 11%.
The tribunal has wrongly taken the disability at 8%.

Hence, the loss of future earning comes to Premala Mehtre vs Anilkumar And Anr on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110075857/
2 Rs.13,250/- X 12 X 14 X 11% = Rs.2,44,860/-.
5.

sentences.text: The tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.1,34,206/- towards medical expenses.
The same is correct and needs no interference.
Due to the injuries, he might have not attended any work for at least four months.
Hence, he is entitled for a sum of Rs.53,000/- (Rs.13,250/- X 4 months).

Considering the nature of injuries, occupation of the claimant and other relevant factors, this Court finds it reasonable to enhance the amount awarded for pain and sufferings to Rs.75,000/-, Rs.30,000/-
towards loss of amenities and Rs.30,000/- towards transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
In view of the opinion of the Doctor, a sum of Rs.25,000/- is awarded towards future medical expenses i.e. for removal of implants.

Hence, the total compensation would be as under:

Learned counsel for the Insurance company submits that, the award amount passed by the tribunal has been already deposited.
7. The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,92,066/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum as against Rs.3,40,166/- awarded by the tribunal.

8. Accordingly, the following order:
ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part:
(ii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,92,060/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of NC: 2025:KHC-K:6512 HC-KAR petition till the date of realization as against Rs.3,40,166/- awarded by the Premala Mehtre vs Anilkumar And Anr on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110075857/
3 tribunal;
(iii) The respondent No.2-Insurance company is directed to deposit the enhanced compensation of Rs.2,51,900/- along with interest within a period of one month from the date of this order;
(iv) On such deposit, the claimant is permitted with withdraw the entire compensation amount along with interest accrued thereon.
